strategy.note: basis: Tab. 4.25 'Sachbilanzdaten für das Modul "Strom, Hochspannung / Mittelspannung / Niederspannung, ab Netz (CH)"', column 'electricity, low voltage, production CH, at grid', per 1 kWh; allocation: none stated. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

gaps_reported_by_model: The report prints only the Swiss SUPPLY-MIX columns. The route-specific dataset ('production from hard coal') differs in the loss amount and the SF6 level, which the excerpt does not tabulate (it refers to Tab. 4.27 for those).
The upstream input must be the medium-voltage dataset of the same production route, not the Swiss mix; the excerpt names the structure but not that dataset.
Ozone and dinitrogen monoxide emissions appear only in the high-voltage column, so they are not part of the low-voltage dataset.
